title: AI
subtitle: Control AI features, the spending cap, and the models used.

master.label: Enable AI
master.helper: Master switch. When off, no cloud AI feature runs regardless of the settings below.

threshold.label: Auto-apply confidence threshold
threshold.helper: Above this value (0 to 1) an AI-suggested categorization is applied automatically.
threshold.invalid: The threshold must be between 0 and 1

budget.label: Monthly cap (US$)
budget.helper: Hard monthly cap on cloud AI spend. 0 disables all calls — the app stays fully functional.
budget.invalid: The cap must be zero or greater

keys.label: API keys
keys.helper: Keys are stored encrypted on the server and are never shown here. Leave blank to keep the current key; use "Clear" to revert to the environment variable.

usage.title: Usage
usage.subtitle: AI spend for {{month}}.
usage.empty: No AI usage recorded this month.

loadError: Could not load your AI settings. Try again.
saveError: Could not save your settings. Try again.

suggestions.title: AI Suggestions
suggestions.subtitle: Review AI-suggested categorizations and accept, reject, or turn them into a rule.
suggestions.emptyHint: Run categorization to generate suggestions for uncategorized transactions.
suggestions.runEnqueued: Categorization enqueued. Suggestions will refresh shortly.
suggestions.acceptError: Could not accept the suggestion. Refreshing the list.
suggestions.rejectError: Could not reject the suggestion. Refreshing the list.
suggestions.bulkAcceptError: Could not accept the selected suggestions.

forecast.title: Month forecast
forecast.empty: No forecast for this month yet.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Ask about your spending, budget, and net worth. The numbers come from your data.
assistant.threadEmpty: Start the conversation by sending a message.
assistant.streamError: Could not finish the reply. Try again.
assistant.networkError: Connection to the assistant failed. Try again.

action.title: Confirm action
action.alreadyDecided: This action was already decided or has expired.
